name: Save Restricted Content Bot v3
description: Fast forwarder for restricted private and public Telegram channels

OWNER_ID.description: User ID(s) to be set as bot owner(s), separated by space (e.g., 1234 5678)

STRING.description: Pyrogram session string of a Telegram Premium account. Required only for uploads above 2GB

LOG_GROUP.description: Channel/group ID (with -100 prefix) used to stage files above 2GB. The bot must be admin there

FORCE_SUB.description: Channel ID (with -100 prefix) users must join. Leave 0 to disable

MASTER_KEY.description: Master key used for session encryption. Change this to your own value

IV_KEY.description: Initialization vector key for session encryption. Change this to your own value

WORKERS.description: How many files are downloaded in parallel per batch

MAX_TRANSMISSIONS.description: Parallel chunk streams per file transfer. Biggest speed lever, 8-16 works well

BATCH_DELAY.description: Seconds to wait between two posts of a batch. 0 is fastest

BATCH_LIMIT.description: Maximum posts allowed in one /batch run
